displayDescription: A refractive glass droplet swells over a striped board and branches into four connected glass nodes.
styleRenderer: MeshPhysicalMaterial (transmission, ior, thickness, attenuation, dispersion, clearcoat)
Three.js internal offscreen transmission render target
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15 paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (sole owner of state proxy and text properties)
Deterministic vertex displacement computed from tl.time()
limitations: Real-time rasterized transmission, not path-traced: one refraction through screen space, so other glass objects are not seen through glass and there are no caustics.
Dispersion is three.js's per-channel IOR offset, kept low.
The liquid wobble is analytic vertex displacement, not fluid simulation.
Blender, Cycles and EEVEE were not used, per the user's instruction.
No preview_recipes were supplied in STYLE.json, so this refresh shows the primary style with a new scene-dependent background.
The renderer was not run by the agent; host QA is pending.
